class: Several panels on one screen each fetching or computing the same figure their own way: they show different numbers for one thing, at different ages.
mechanism: A panel read once, a live-socket table total was taken before charges, and a tracking box ran its own 5 s read.

first_seen.evidence: One trade showed +29.25, +22.75 and +58.50; the gap 35.75 = 0.55 per unit x 65.

fix: One paper-book read per refresh feeds the panel, the tracking box headline and the table TOTAL row, with one as-of time.

detection.note: Unguarded: no named check is confirmed to cover the class; the proof was one real run, not a standing check.

occurrences.evidence: One trade showed +29.25, +22.75 and +58.50; the gap 35.75 = 0.55 per unit x 65.
